title: Lansdale has Yamashita's driver tortured to find 12 troves

tellings.quote: troves are there. So what he does is he he kidnaps the driver for General Yakushima who would know where the some of them were, right?

plain: In Manila in 1945, an American officer named Ed Lansdale had the driver of the Japanese general Yamashita kidnapped and tortured so he would reveal where hidden troves of treasure were buried, according to a researcher named Dan Sheehan. Sheehan, who calls the general "Yakushima", says the driver would have known where some of the twelve stashes were. He tells it without naming a source, as part of a story about secret wealth that he says later funded hidden government work.
